about: Wilson G. Jones is a top-rated attorney who practices law in Dallas, Texas. Wilson Jones focuses on Health Care issues.

Wilson Jones received Super Lawyers designation for 2012 - 2026. He was selected for this honor subsequent to undergoing an evaluation of many different factors including peer recognition and professional achievement.
He became a licensed attorney in 1992. Before practicing law, he attended law school at The University of Texas School of Law and graduated in 1992.

The Super Lawyers patented selection process is peer influenced and research driven, selecting the top 5% of attorneys to the Super Lawyers lists each year. We know lawyers and make it easy to connect with them.
